titulo: How multiplication helps protect your data

frases: How can a simple multiplication help protect information on the Internet?
We know the factors, and calculating the product is easy.
Now imagine I only give you the number seventy-seven.
Can you discover which two prime numbers produced it?
The difference of two squares lets us rewrite a subtraction as a multiplication.
The square root of seventy-seven lies between eight and nine.
Nine squared is eighty-one. Subtract seventy-seven, and we get four.
Four is two squared. Now we apply the algebraic identity.
Nine minus two is seven, and nine plus two is eleven. We found the factors.
RSA builds a public key using the product of two very large prime numbers.
Recovering those primes from the product can be much harder when the numbers are enormous.
This is an educational example, not a practical way to break modern RSA.
